integration_issues.issue: Sonner toasts render in bottom-right with a much higher z-index than the court-ai-fab (z-55). For the first ~4-5 seconds after the Legal Acknowledgement toast appears (and whenever another toast is active in that corner), the toast visually and clickably overlaps the FAB — a Playwright page.click() through the real pointer path gets intercepted by the toast and the chat does NOT open; JS .click() still works because it bypasses pointer events. Real users will perceive this as the Emergent AI Assistant button being unresponsive right after accepting the invite / after other toasts. Fix: either raise FAB z-index above the toaster, or move the toaster to top-right / top-center on the Court page, or add a right-margin offset on the FAB while toasts are visible.

action_items: Resolve FAB vs sonner-toaster stacking: bump court-ai-fab z-index above the Toaster (sonner defaults to a very high z-index) OR position Toaster away from bottom-right on the Court page. Current real-user impact: 'Emergent AI Assistant' button appears unclickable for a few seconds after any toast appears in the bottom-right corner.
critical_code_review_comments: CourtChatPanel.jsx FAB uses z-[55]; sonner default toast z is 9999+. Any bottom-right toast overlays and blocks pointer events on the FAB.

The review's example valid code 'SA-DEMO01' is a joint-report case_id, not a seeded court key — only ALIGN-SA-2026 and COURT-8842 are in portal_court_keys. Consider adding SA-DEMO01 to _SEED_COURT_KEYS so test scripts that use it work out of the box, OR update the acceptance-flow docs/UX helper text to list the real demo keys.
GET /api/portal/state wraps state as {exists, state:{...}}; callers (frontend already handles both, but) should keep that in mind — a flat response could tempt a future refactor.

The GUI's court-ai-fab must be clicked via native JS click (page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"court-ai-fab\"]').click()")) OR after waiting ~5s for toasts to vanish, because sonner toasts in the bottom-right corner intercept Playwright's pointer-based clicks. rca of the issue: FAB stacking issue — Root cause: Tailwind z-[55] on .court-fab vs sonner's internal data-sonner-toaster z-index (~999999). Reproduction: load Court page, immediately after the 'All three reflections complete' / 'Court invite accepted...' toast appears, click court-ai-fab via a real mouse pointer within ~5s — the toast at bottom-right receives the pointer event instead and the chat does not open. Mitigation: raise FAB z-index to e.g. z-[9999999] or re-anchor the Toaster away from bottom-right.
